# LR 2026-11-22 (user): TEST, not for release. Potentes 936 start (99_LR_test_potentes_5936.txt): the non-Roman
# dynasties that rule Eastern Roman land as warlords in 1066 start as Potentes dug into the counties they will
# rule. Generated by tools/potentes_test_936.py; edit the house list there and re-run it.
# Root: the house's character (LR_test_potentes.0001).

LR_test_potentes_setup_effect = {
	save_scope_as = lr_test_owner
	add_character_flag = {
		flag = LR_entrenchment_setup # no host reaction while the house is set up
		days = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { this = character:LR_pot936_rodulf }
		create_merchant_title_effect = {
			REASON = flag:voluntary
			FLAVOR_CHAR = scope:lr_test_owner
		}
		add_realm_law_skip_effects = company_size_large
		LR_make_potentes_effect = yes
		add_gold = 400
		domicile ?= { move_domicile = title:c_cephalonia.title_province }
		title:c_cephalonia.title_province = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { exists = trade_post_district } }
				add_trade_post_district = {
					district = trade_post_location_district
					owner = scope:lr_test_owner
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { trade_post_owner ?= scope:lr_test_owner }
				trade_post_district = {
					replace_building_effect = pb_trade_office_04
					add_building = lr_tower_house_01
					replace_building_effect = lr_tower_house_04
					add_building = trade_watchtower_01
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = LR_entrenched_house
					value = scope:lr_test_owner.house
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = LR_entrenched_since
					value = 5890
				}
			}
		}
		title:c_corfu.title_province = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { exists = trade_post_district } }
				add_trade_post_district = {
					district = trade_post_location_district
					owner = scope:lr_test_owner
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { trade_post_owner ?= scope:lr_test_owner }
				trade_post_district = {
					replace_building_effect = pb_trade_office_04
					add_building = lr_tower_house_01
					replace_building_effect = lr_tower_house_02
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = LR_entrenched_house
					value = scope:lr_test_owner.house
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = LR_entrenched_since
					value = 5915
				}
			}
		}
		LR_entrenchment_update_owner_effect = yes
	}
